results.output: Lucid Sentence is a free, open-source word processor designed for .docx files. It preserves Word's familiar ribbon interface to ensure familiarity for existing users while introducing a refined aesthetic through meticulous typography. The application is available for desktop use, Android devices, and as a home-screen web app on iOS and iPadOS. Optional on-device AI features allow users to rewrite selected text, correct grammar, summarize content, and convert plain-language requests into ribbon commands; however, all processing occurs locally, ensuring no documents are transmitted to external servers. Every AI-generated edit is presented as a suggestion, allowing the user to accept or reject it, thereby guaranteeing that the document remains unchanged without any backdoor modifications.
The team went to the meeting yesterday and they were very happy with their results; it was a good outcome.

Lucid Sentence is a free, open-source word processor that preserves Word's familiar interface while offering a fresh design and on-device AI features for editing, summarizing, and rewriting documents without sending them anywhere.
